content:
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal
The AADSpnSignInEventsBeta  table in the advanced hunting schema contains information about
Microsoft Entra service principal and managed identity sign-ins. You can learn more about the
different kinds of sign-ins in Microsoft Entra sign-in activity reports - preview.
Use this reference to construct queries that return information from the table.
For information on other tables in the advanced hunting schema, see the advanced hunting
reference.
Column name
Data
type
Description
Timestamp
datetime
Date and time when the record was generated
Application
string
Application that performed the recorded action
ApplicationId
string
Unique identifier for the application
IsManagedIdentity
boolean
Indicates whether the sign-in was initiated by a managed identity
） Important
On December 9, 2025, the AADSpnSignInEventsBeta  table will be replaced by
EntraIdSpnSignInEvents. This change will be made to remove the former's preview status
and to align it with the existing product branding.
The EntraIdSpnSignInEvents  table is already available. To ensure a smooth transition,
make sure that you update your queries that use the AADSpnSignInEventsBeta  table to use
EntraIdSpnSignInEvents  before the previously mentioned date.
） Important
The AADSpnSignInEventsBeta  table is currently in beta and is being offered on a short-term
basis to allow you to hunt through Microsoft Entra sign-in events. Customers need to have
a Microsoft Entra ID P2 license to collect and view activities for this table.
ﾉ
